leadText:
This is the fifth and final chapter of the I Can't Choose, Eevee manga. It was first published on Poké Times on December 10, 2024 at 8:00 PM JST. It is 8 pages long.

This is one of three possible endings to the manga. It was determined as the final chapter by the number of reposts the previous chapters received. Specifically, the second chapter garnered more reposts than the third and fourth chapters.
